summary: English single-report template of Clinic C in the manufacturer's own branding: a full-bleed cover in a content control, a report summary page with questionnaire, task and classifier summaries, a brain function profile grid and the recommendation lead-in, a table of contents, then the master chapters (questionnaires, task, resting EEG, spectra, indices, ERPs, classifiers, HRV) and a closing chapter of fixed treatment texts and text-module markers. It has no AI interpretation markers.

theme.cover: title page: a Word cover-page content control on page 1 with a full-bleed dark navy top band (210 x 38 mm) holding a white title text box and a title bitmap (about 108 x 18 mm), a large centred logo (about 120 x 36 mm), the identity and order lines, and a full-bleed light grey bottom band (210 x 37 mm) with a lime green rule, a small logo and an address text box in place of the footer; no running header or footer on page 1

fonts.families: theme fonts Trebuchet MS (headings) and Calibri (body); runs set to Calibri, Tahoma for complex script, Trebuchet MS in a few headings
fonts.sizes_pt: mostly 11, also 12, 10, 8 and 14; cover title 28 and 36; hidden control line 1

colours: dark navy header, footer, cover band and accents
white cover title and hidden control line
pale green and light lime shading in the profile grid
light grey and light blue shaded label bars
dark blue and mid blue text in places
header: patient slots (last name, first name, birth date)
footer: company line (company name, postal and web address)

images.other: logos: large cover logo and a small logo placed twice (cover foot, footer), 2 files; banner: cover title bitmap; other: 11 placements of 10 static localisation pictures in the ICA component tables, 1 scanned signature, 1 picture bullet, 1 tiny theme fill image; shapes: 3 cover bands, 2 cover text boxes, 3 legend text boxes, 1 footer text box

theme_gaps: different first page: cover without running header and footer, with its own footer band, small logo and address box
full-bleed cover built as a Word cover-page content control from layered shapes, text boxes and a title bitmap
running header with patient slots (name, birth date) and a page number field, from page 2
footer with a logo and a floating address text box
automatic heading numbering (roman chapters, arabic sections, letter subsections), used by the table of contents
33 manual page breaks; spectra headings, legends and figures share one paragraph per condition
picture bullet in a list style
legend text coloured to match the fixed device curve colours, which couples clinic text colour to device colours

not_expressible.what: Typed cross references to page numbers on the summary page
not_expressible.why: No block generates page references; Word computes them
not_expressible.suggestion: Generated references to block titles at render time, or none; no clinic-typed page references

not_expressible.what: Word table of contents with page numbers
not_expressible.why: The schema has no generated table of contents
not_expressible.suggestion: A company-owned table-of-contents block built at render time from the block titles

not_expressible.what: Brain function profile grid with clinic-defined rows of mental-function and condition labels, filled by hand
not_expressible.why: Clinician input in a fixed table layout; clinician blocks are free text
not_expressible.suggestion: Leave out: its rows name mental functions and conditions (spec 3.2, intended use section 4). The clinician's own judgement goes into free clinician text

not_expressible.what: Recording parameters, montage, durations and norm comparison typed as clinic text
not_expressible.why: Facts of the recording typed as clinic text can contradict the device
not_expressible.suggestion: Device metadata placeholders and a device method block; template validation that rejects such facts in clinic text

not_expressible.what: Norm database description with a claim of regulatory approval
not_expressible.why: The norm description and its status belong to the versioned device record; the claim is unsupported
not_expressible.suggestion: Device method block that states the norm version from the technical file; claim-word check rejects regulatory claims in clinic text

not_expressible.what: Fixed named signatory in the closing block
not_expressible.why: A report is final when the clinician issues it (spec 3.5); a typed name makes every report look signed by that person
not_expressible.suggestion: A device issued-by block filled at issue from the issuing user (name, qualification, date and time, report version); no named signatories or signature images in clinic blocks
